The Inspector suggests Hasmukh’s family to take the help of ‘Vastu Shastra’ to resolve their family problems. Hasmukh’s lawyer tells him that his sister-in-law is a ‘Feng Shui’ expert. He assures Hasmukh’s family that ‘Feng Shui’ would solve all their issues.
